pinned.name: Time_Warp_Studio
pinned.description: An old-school programming environment: eleven interpreters from 1964-1980, a full IDE, a debugger in every language and turtle graphics -- plus two complete machines, the HB-1 home computer of 1982 with its own disk OS, and a live CHIP-8 with an assembler and register inspector.

pinned.name: Mellivora_OS_PicoCalc
pinned.description: Mellivora OS port for the Clockwork PicoCalc handheld device, featuring a full shell, productivity applications, BASIC and Tiny C interpreters, scripting support, and extensive documentation.

pinned.name: GulfOfMexico
pinned.description: Esoteric programming language interpreter — -1-based indexing, three-valued booleans, tiered & tilde equality, temporal lifetimes, compound assignment, emoji identifiers, negative hoisting, and a 5-theme GUI IDE. 170 tests, 26 demos. Based on Lu Wilson's (TodePond) DreamBerd spec.

pinned.name: Mellivora_OS
pinned.description: Mellivora OS is a from-scratch hobby OS that boots on real x86 hardware or in QEMU. It includes a custom HBFS v3 filesystem with permissions and xattr, ring 3 user-mode execution, a DOS-inspired interactive shell with POSIX features,

pinned.name: TesseraGrid
pinned.description: Tessera Grid — a fast Rust/egui cellular-automata simulator with 10 rule sets, 8 themes, headless CLI and PNG/GIF/RLE export
